messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC200401 triggered for synth-canary-eu-1 — 5/5 probe failures in last 2m. Severity: P1. Auto-escalation: on.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC200401 created and notified oncall @riley (oncall) — see https://pagerduty.example/INC200401

riley (oncall): ack — I'm on it. opening runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/synth-canary

alex (SRE): FYI seeing spike in 502s from canary agents in eu1. Correlates with deploy around 2004009000.

deploy-bot: deploy bg-probe v3.2.0 @2004009000 by sam (deploy id: d-789)

sam (eng-runtime): rolled a probe config tweak 22m ago (timeout 300->120s). past 3 mins probes show HTTP/502 and TCP resets. pasting probe output:
```
> curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" https://synth-eu1.redwood.test/check
502
502
200
502
502
```

kevin (support): support queue: 3 customers complaining about "can't reach api" in EU, tickets #1234 #1237 #1240. Sending heads-up to account teams.

riley (oncall): ok. sam, can you try restarting probe agents and bumping pool size? alex, any quick mitigation like diverting canary traffic to fallback region?

sam (eng-runtime): restarting probe agent on eu1 now. command:
```
sudo systemctl restart redwood-probe && journalctl -u redwood-probe -n 200 --no-pager
```

ops-bot: restart command issued on eu1-host-7 by sam. Output: service restarted, health checks failing.

sam (eng-runtime): restarted but still seeing 502s. scaling probe pool 1->3 to widen sampling.

alex (SRE): toggling synth routing: divert synth-canary-eu-1 -> synth-canary-eu-fallback. Applying traffic-policy.

deploy-bot: traffic-policy updated for synth-canary-eu-1 (now hitting fallback region)

maria (infra): on it. looking at cache cluster logs — recent change set lowered max_conn to 50 accidentally earlier today. Bumping max_conn -> 500 now.

ops-bot: cluster-config apply queued for cache-eu1. Change id cc-112

maria (infra): applied, restarting cache workers on eu1 nodes.

incident-bot: alert rate dropping — current failures 1/5 in last 2m. Auto-escalation suspended.

kevin (support): customers reporting the API requests are back to normal.

riley (oncall): monitoring. leaving probes diverted for 10m to ensure stability. Will create follow-up to gate cache config rollouts and add metric for max_conn.

riley (oncall): marking INC200401 acknowledged -> resolved in PD after monitoring. Thanks all :tada: :coffee: 

alex (SRE): follow-up item: create card to add integration test that simulates probe load + config guardrails. I'll pick it up.

sam (eng-runtime): logging timeline and commands in the runbook.

maria (infra): noted, will add an alert when cache max_conn falls below threshold.

riley (oncall): closing thread — last check green. If anything reappears ping me directly. Good job team.
